categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: semiconductor distribution and commercial lighting. Semiconductor distribution, led by subsidiary Bosida, focuses on RF and communication devices, digital and analog chips, and other semiconductor components for applications in smartphones, consumer electronics, IoT, and automotive electronics. The commercial lighting segment provides integrated lighting design, manufacturing, and system services, including lighting fixtures, LED displays, and optical signage, targeting retail, hospitality, and commercial spaces.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The semiconductor distribution segment leverages authorized distribution of advanced semiconductor products from global manufacturers, providing technical support and supply chain services. The commercial lighting segment emphasizes customized lighting design, flexible manufacturing with integrated production chains covering prototyping, mold development, LED module production, and assembly. The company invests in R&D for AI-based smart locks, spatial audio, wireless conferencing, automotive multimedia, millimeter-wave radar, intelligent charging piles, and smart store management platforms, integrating IoT, AI, and smart control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major smartphone manufacturers (e.g., Xiaomi, OPPO, VIVO, TCL), consumer electronics firms, IoT device makers, automotive electronics companies (e.g., BYD), and commercial brands in apparel, home textiles, retail, and hospitality sectors. The semiconductor products serve downstream electronics manufacturers, while commercial lighting solutions cater to brand retail stores, shopping centers, supermarkets, hotels, and entertainment venues.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong and international sales. Semiconductor distribution sales are predominantly to overseas customers or supply chains, while commercial lighting serves domestic clients nationwide. Key subsidiaries are located in Fujian, Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Hong Kong, with export activities under FOB and CIF terms.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions mainly as a midstream distributor in the semiconductor supply chain, bridging upstream semiconductor manufacturers and downstream electronic product manufacturers. In commercial lighting, it acts as a solution provider integrating design, manufacturing, and system services, positioned downstream delivering finished lighting products and solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technical service capabilities in semiconductor distribution, expanding product lines in smartphones, automotive electronics, and IoT, and enhancing R&D in semiconductor application solutions. In commercial lighting, focus is on intelligent, green, and high-end lighting solutions integrating IoT, 5G, and smart controls, expanding smart store business and overseas ODM. R&D projects target AI-enabled smart locks, spatial audio, wireless conferencing, automotive multimedia, millimeter-wave radar, smart charging piles, and smart store management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales in semiconductor distribution and commercial lighting. The semiconductor segment earns revenue by authorized distribution of semiconductor components combined with technical support and supply chain services. The commercial lighting segment generates revenue from sales of customized lighting fixtures, LED displays, and integrated lighting solutions, including installation and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In semiconductor distribution, competitors include large domestic players like Haoshanghao, Runxin Technology, and Liyuan Information, as well as global distributors such as Arrow Electronics and Avnet. Bosida ranks among the top 20 domestic distributors. In commercial lighting, competitors include Sanxiong Aurora, Opple Lighting, and Sunshine Lighting. The company positions itself as a leading domestic semiconductor distributor and a professional commercial lighting solutions provider with strong brand recognition and technical capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.57 billion, a slight decrease of 2.68% year-over-year, with semiconductor distribution accounting for over 83% of revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 19.44% to RMB 51.16 million. The company maintains total assets around RMB 2.07 billion and net assets of RMB 1.25 billion. Despite some revenue decline, profitability improved, supported by stable cash flow and ongoing R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technical support and supply chain integration in semiconductor distribution, offering authorized products from leading global manufacturers and tailored solutions to meet diverse customer needs. In commercial lighting, it differentiates through customized, integrated lighting design and manufacturing, flexible production capabilities, and smart lighting innovations that enhance brand image and consumer experience. Its R&D-driven innovation in AI, IoT, and smart control technologies further strengthens its competitive edge.
